description:
Query SWATGenX's national groundwater inventory (well records and lithology logs harvested
    from state agencies across the contiguous U.S.; live totals at
    https://www.swatgenx.com/api/gw-wells/summary) near a point — the subsurface data used to
    parameterise MODFLOW. Returns the nearest
    wells with lithology-interval count and a richness_tier grading what each well EXPOSES:
    0 = well record with no water level or yield (many carry no logged lithology),
    1 = + hydraulics (static water level / yield / depth),
    2 = + screened interval & yield (groundwater-model-ready). The tier is about attribute
    coverage, not log detail. Per-interval depths live in the full inventory DB (Zenodo), not
    this index. lat/lon in decimal degrees (EPSG:4326); radius_km up to ~50.
name: query_groundwater
title: Query national groundwater wells
